title: Break VERITAS: External Verification Challenge

reference_contract.answer_key_visibility: The reference implementation is public. Independence means a separately implemented verification path, not source blindness.

full_v4_boundary.reason: The complete V4 archive currently grants no public distribution or modification license.
full_v4_boundary.required_next_step: An explicit copyright-holder license and public release decision is required before a full-kernel track can open.

independence_requirements: Do not import, call, wrap, transpile, or vendor the reference evaluator as the submitted implementation.
Publish source, dependency lock, exact commands, and result artifacts at an immutable commit.
Exercise clean positive controls as well as hostile cases.
Report mismatches and untested boundaries without narrative repair.
Disclose relationships, compensation, reused code, AI assistance, and shared dependencies.

tracks.title: Break the action boundary
tracks.positive_control_rule: Pair every hostile mutation with the unchanged clean packet.

tracks.title: Break monitoring and revocation
tracks.positive_control_rule: Include a heartbeat inside its declared TTL.

submission.counting_rule: A report remains uncounted until identity, independence, method, provenance, scope, deduplication, and Protocol v2 caps are verified.
